description:
Records who is on your own side — colleagues, advisors, investors, customers, former teammates. Orbb maps the public record, and who you can reach through is the half only you hold: every later answer is better for having it.

The names in a CRM, an inbox, a calendar or call recordings belong here. It adds and never removes, and one call carries up to a hundred people.

Free.

kind.description: YOUR USER'S OWN WORD FOR IT, not the nearest one of ours — "design partner", "former colleague", "board member". The vocabulary is open on purpose.

people.description: The people on your user's own side of the table.

note.description: Anything that changes how the relationship should be used: who owns it, how warm, when it was last live, what not to ask for.
